target.title: fix(ci): accept valid Kova PASS records without violations
target.body:
Follow-up to #102894.

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where the performance release gate rejected a valid filtered
Kova report when a successful record omitted the optional `violations` field.

## Why This Change Was Made

The adapter now treats an omitted record `violations` property as an empty
list. It remains fail-closed for any present non-array value, hidden violations
on passing records, and failed records without a non-empty violations array.

## User Impact

Release operators can use valid Kova partial and profiled reports without a
false `invalid record violations` failure. OpenClaw runtime behavior is
unchanged.

## Evidence

- Exact live candidate artifact from
  https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29033182550 now exits zero
  as `filtered-partial`; the prior adapter exited one with
  `invalid record violations`.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kx3vjzm1a4qv96yhty90dy7v` on exact head
  `764de3df4e9a62448f5b0071cd44eed3bf4840ba`:
  - `pnpm test:serial test/scripts/kova-report-gate.test.ts`: 91 passed.
  - `pnpm check:changed`: passed with zero lint warnings or errors.
- Structured Codex autoreview: clean, no accepted or actionable findings.

AI-assisted change; implementation and proof reviewed by the submitting
maintainer.
